correctness.rationale: For all n>=3 and all binary weight-three words, direct factor lengths for 0,1,2,3 ones are consecutive integer intervals with five explicit boundary statistics. Four of them recover the unordered interior/endpoint zero-gap pairs; the fifth discriminates the only two reversal orbits exactly unless min interior >= max exterior with both pairs unequal. Unique nonnegative parameterization gives n=7+4t+3u+2v+r and the restricted partition generating series. Burnside reflection count gives J_n, and the order-four pole yields the asymptotic. Independent direct Parikh-set brute enumeration and canonical-gap checks pass; finite tests are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The Parikh-set observation is the natural exact answer to all binary jumbled-pattern-existence queries, and measuring its inverse ambiguity is a structural reconstruction problem. Hamming weights at most two determine the input up to reversal, whereas at three the theorem gives the exact first failure, full necessary/sufficient gap conditions, all fiber cardinalities, a nontrivial all-length generating function, and a sharp limiting positive fraction 1/6. The partition bijection is explanatory rather than an arbitrary numerical slice; no broader weights are claimed.
